top_posts.summary: OpenClaw beta release introduces live browser control using Google's remote debugging feature in the latest Chrome (enabled via chrome://inspect#remote-debugging). The update also adds a new 'user' profile session, with the agent automatically determining when to use browser control or accepting manual direction.
A quick tip for macOS users who need to run multiple instances of the Codex app simultaneously by launching it directly from its binary path in the terminal.
